basic_profile.headline: Building the Future of Audit || Co-Founder @DocRack || IIT Bombay
basic_profile.name: Tejash Chauhan
basic_profile.summary: Hey, I'm Tejash Chauhan, a final-year student at IIT Bombay and the co-founder of DocRack.I'm driven by curiosity and enjoy working at the intersection of AI, software systems, and business. I like understanding how complex systems work, questioning assumptions, and building technology that solves real operational problem not just interesting technical ones.Currently, I'm focused on reducing enterprise audit cycles from weeks to days by building AI systems that understand documents, verify information, and automate repetitive knowledge work. I enjoy creating products that transform scattered data into structured, trustworthy, and actionable insights, enabling teams to make faster and better decisions.Beyond my current work, I'm fascinated by how AI, intelligent software, and emerging technologies are reshaping the way organizations operate. I enjoy thinking about product strategy, system design, and the intersection of technology, workflows, and execution.I believe the best products come from deeply understanding both people and systems, and that meaningful innovation happens when strong technical thinking meets relentless execution.Always happy to connect with founders, engineers, operators, and anyone building ambitious technology.

current.company_description: DocRack is a privacy-first AI audit engine built for Indian CA firms and statutory auditors. DocRack is a privacy-first AI audit engine built for Indian CA firms and statutory auditors. It automates the most time-intensive parts of a statutory audit — cross-document verification, ledger classification, GST and TDS reconciliation, sampling, working paper generation, and audit trail management — all aligned to ICAI standards and the Standards on Auditing.Every number DocRack produces ties back to its source document, and every action in the system is cryptographically signed and timestamped. The result is an audit file that is tamper-evident and NFRA inspection-ready from day one.Unlike generic document AI tools, DocRack is built ground-up for the Indian audit context — Schedule III, Form 3CD, CARO 2020, GSTR-9C, and the complete statutory workflow from engagement setup to UDIN sign-off. Client data stays in India and never leaves the firm's control.CA firms use DocRack to compress audits from months to a few days, eliminate manual reconciliation work, and produce defensible, traceable audit documentation — without changing how their teams already work.
current.description:
DocRack is an AI-powered platform for internal and external audit, built for the audit and accounting teams who do the actual fieldwork.
 
Audit still runs on samples, scattered evidence and working papers rebuilt by hand. DocRack changes that. It reads the evidence, tests the full population instead of a sample, and produces the working paper at the end of the run.
 
AI handles extraction, a deterministic engine handles the testing, so results are repeatable and every number traces straight back to the document it came from. Maker-checker review and typed verdicts on every exception are part of the workflow, not an afterthought.
 
All data stays in India by design.
 
Working with top enterprises. Backed by NVIDIA Inception.

past.company_description: Abhyuday, IIT Bombay is a student run organization working towards creating a sense of Social Responsibility and Leadership among the youth of India. Abhyuday was conceptualized as a movement by socially conscious students and professors of IIT Bombay in the years 2011 and 2012 in support of the ‘Anti-Corruption’ and ‘Women’s Right’ protests then going on in the country. Deriving its name from the Sanskrit word meaning ‘The Rising’, Abhyuday has established itself as India’s Largest Students Body for Social Development in the mere span of time. Taking forward IIT Bombay’s Senate mandated requirement of participating in Student Gymkhana activities of Sports, Culture and Social Service, Abhyuday serves as an avenue for students to start their journey of self-development while contributing towards the Society. Abhyuday encompasses a large spectrum of activities that aims at modelling the youth to work towards solving World’s Social Problems & our ‘Initiatives’ focus on creating a positive impact on the local communities. The ‘Social Fest’ is a two day extravaganza that celebrates the spirit of Social Good.We invite you to be a part of India’s Largest Student Run Movement for Social Good.
past.description:

Played a key role in organizing and executing projects such as the Powai Lake Cleanup, DIY Central Park, and food donation drives. Collaborated with local communities, managed on-ground logistics, and helped mobilize student participation to drive meaningful civic engagement.
